NOAA_DATA.noaa_gsod.gsod2020.hail: Indicators for the occurrence during the day

NOAA_DATA.noaa_gsod.gsod2020.tornado_funnel_cloud: Indicators for the occurrence during the day
NOAA_DATA.noaa_gsod.gsod2020.thunder: Indicators for the occurrence during the day

NOAA_DATA.noaa_gsod.gsod2020.count_wdsp: Number of observations used in calculating mean wind speed
NOAA_DATA.noaa_gsod.gsod2020.rain_drizzle: Indicators for the occurrence during the day

US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_REL.RELATED_GEO_NAME: Name of the place related to GEO_NAME. This is a place that overlaps or is contained within the primary geo (e.g., city within a state)
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_REL.RELATED_GEO_ID: A unique identifier for the related place joinable to the GEOGRAPHY_INDEX table
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_REL.RELATED_LEVEL: Geographic level or hierarchy of the related place (e.g., Country, State, County, City, Continent, CountrySubRegion, etc.)
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_REL.RELATIONSHIP_TYPE: Relationship between the two places. Contains means the RELATED_GEO_ID is fully contained within the GEO_ID (e.g., relationship of state to a city) while Overlaps indicates the GEO_ID is a subpart of the RELATED_GEO_ID (e.g., relationship of city to a state)
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_REL.GEO_ID: A unique identifier for a place joinable to the GEOGRAPHY_INDEX table
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_REL.LEVEL: Geographic level or hierarchy (e.g., Country, State, County, City, Continent, CountrySubRegion, etc.)

US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_CHA.RELATIONSHIP_END_DATE: The date through which a given characteristic is valid. For example, if the coordinates for ZIP code 12345 changed on 2023-04-01 (i.e., on 2023-04-01 the Census Bureau released shapefiles with updated coordinates for ZIP code 12345), then relationship_end_date of 2023-03-31 is assigned to the previous coordinates for ZIP code 12345. However, currently, all the values in this column are NULL since it only contains most recent characteristics with no historical changes.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_CHA.RELATIONSHIP_START_DATE: The date from which a given characteristic is valid. For example, if the coordinates for ZIP code 12345 changed on 2023-04-01 (i.e., on 2023-04-01 the Census Bureau released shapefiles with updated coordinates for ZIP code 12345), then relationship_start_date of 2023-04-01 is assigned. However, currently, all the values in this column are NULL since it only contains most recent characteristics with no historical changes.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_CHA.GEO_ID: A unique identifier for a place (a nation, state, zip-code, etc.) joinable to the geography index table for adding geospatial information.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_CHA.RELATIONSHIP_TYPE: Description of the provided characteristic. For example, 'coordinates_wkt' means that VALUE contains the GEO_ID's coordinates in WKT format, while 'coordinates_geojson' means that VALUE contains the GEO_ID's coordinates in GeoJSON format.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_CHA.VALUE: Value of the characteristic specified in RELATIONSHIP_TYPE.

US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTE.CATEGORY_MAIN: Primary category or class of place for the POI.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTE.POI_NAME: Name of the place, merchant, or landmark for the particular the POI.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTE.CATEGORY_ALTERNATE: Alternate categories of the POI. A POI could fit multiple categories (e.g., Restaurant, Burger Restaurant, Fast Food Restaurant), in which case one category would be recorded as CATEGORY_MAIN and the remaining categories would be recorded in a list under CATEGORY_ALTERNATE.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTE.POI_ID: A unique identifier for a point of interest (such as a park, fast food chain, hotel, etc.) based on its description and location. This is joinable to the POINT_OF_INTEREST_ADDRESSES_RELATIONSHIPS table which can be used to link POIs to addresses.

US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.STREET_DIRECTIONAL_SUFFIX: a directional modifier following the street name, such as S or NE
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.STREET_DIRECTIONAL_PREFIX: a directional modifier preceding the street name, such as N or SW
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.ID_ZIP: A unique identifier for a zip code joinable to the geography_index/relationships tables
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.ID_COUNTRY: A unique identifier for a country joinable to the geography_index/relationships tables
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.ADDRESS_ID: A unique identifier of an address based on street address that is joinable to the point_of_interest_addresses_relationships table.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.ZIP: 5-digit code identifying the location of an address
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.ID_STATE: A unique identifier for a state, Washington, D.C. or Puerto Rico joinable to the geography_index/relationships tables
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.UNIT: number or label for a unit used to distinguish multiple tenants at a single address
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.STREET_TYPE: string type of the street, such as ROAD
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.NUMBER: number of the address identifying location on a street
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES.ID_CITY: A unique identifier for a city joinable to the geography_index/relationships tables

US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_IND.GEO_ID: A unique identifier for a place (a nation, state, zip-code, etc.)

US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTE.POI_ID: A unique identifier for a point of interest (such as a park, a branch of a fast food chain, a hotel, etc.) based on its description and location. It is joinable to the point_of_interest_index table.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTE.RELATIONSHIP_TYPE: Relationship between the two places. We use 'Overlaps' to indicate that the POI_ID is a subpart of the ADDRESS_ID (e.g., relationship of an apartment to an apartment building, as there could be several points of interest at the same address, especially if the data is lacking accurate unit information).
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTE.RELATIONSHIP_START_DATE: The date from which a given relationship is valid. For example, if the NAME of a place at a given POI_ID changed on 2023-04-01, then  relationship_start_date of 2023-04-01 is assigned. However, currently, all the values in this column are NULL since it only contains most recent characteristics with no historical changes.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTE.RELATIONSHIP_END_DATE: The date from which a given relationship is valid. For example, if the NAME of a place at a given POI_ID changed on 2023-04-01, then relationship_end_date of 2023-03-31 is assigned to the NAME for that POI_ID. However, currently, all the values in this column are NULL since it only contains most recent characteristics with no historical changes.
US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTE.ADDRESS_ID: A unique identifier for an address based on street address that is joinable to the us_addresses table.
